title: Installation Technician - Glass, Aluminium & Architectural Products
experience: This is a hands-on position suited to versatile professionals with practical installation experience, strong technical abilities, and the confidence to work independently or as part of an installation
description_text:
Our client is an established company in Malta specialising in the supply and installation of a wide range of made-to-measure architectural, glass, aluminium, and outdoor living solutions.
 The company is currently looking for experienced and technically skilled Installation Technicians to join its growing team. The successful candidates will be involved in installing various products across residential, commercial, and hospitality projects.
 This is a hands-on position suited to versatile professionals with practical installation experience, strong technical abilities, and the confidence to work independently or as part of an installation team.
 Key Responsibilities
 Install glass balcony railings, balustrades, and other glass and aluminium systems.
 Assemble and install aluminium pergolas, including motorised systems and associated components.
 Install glass and aluminium partitions, enclosures, and related systems.
 Carry out the installation of internal doors, hotel doors, and other door systems.
 Install shower cubicles and other made-to-measure glass products.
 Assist with the installation of additional products within the company's portfolio, including shading systems, decking, and other architectural solutions.
 Interpret technical drawings, installation plans, and product specifications.
 Take accurate site measurements and ensure installations are completed according to the required dimensions.
 Use professional tools, machinery, and installation equipment safely and correctly.
 Ensure all installations meet the required quality, safety, and finishing standards.
 Identify and resolve installation-related issues on site.
 Coordinate with colleagues, supervisors, and other trades to ensure projects are completed efficiently.
 Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in good condition.
 Represent the company professionally when working at customer premises and project sites.
 Requirements
 Proven practical experience in the installation of glass, aluminium, doors, pergolas, railings, or similar architectural products.
 Strong technical and hands-on installation abilities.
 Ability to interpret technical drawings and installation specifications.
 Competence in taking accurate site measurements.
 Good knowledge of professional installation tools, equipment, and techniques.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
 Good problem-solving skills and a practical approach to on-site challenges.
 Reliable, organised, and capable of managing assigned tasks and deadlines.
 Previous experience working across different product categories would be a strong advantage.
 Important: This position is intended for experienced and skilled installers. Applications from trainees or candidates with only general labouring experience will not be considered.
 What Our Client Offers
 Gross annual salary of up to €30,000 , depending on experience and technical capabilities.
 The opportunity to work with a diverse range of architectural and made-to-measure products.
 Exposure to residential, commercial, and hospitality installation projects.
 The opportunity to develop further technical expertise within an established company.
 The possibility of joining a growing installation team.
 International Candidates
 Our client is open to considering suitable candidates currently based in Malta as well as experienced international applicants who are willing to relocate to Malta.
 Candidates holding an EU passport will be particularly advantageous.
 If you are an experienced installer with strong technical skills and take pride in delivering high-quality workmanship, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
